subject: Rideshare surge mitigation + key handoff protocol for 12/11 exec offsite
raw_messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Sarah Ortiz <sarah@acme.events>, BlueLine Ops <ops@blueline.com>
Date: Fri, 26 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Rideshare surge mitigation + key handoff protocol for 12/11 exec offsite

Team / Sarah / BlueLine,

We need a tight on-the-ground plan for the exec offsite on 12/11 (approx. 45 attendees arriving across 3 flights between 12:00–15:30). Primary concerns are: rideshare surge preventing timely pickups, secure key/vehicle handoffs for 6 reserved rental cars, and a short-term parking footprint for driver staging.

High-level asks: 
- Marcus: primary on-day ops lead (arrival coordination, vendor liaison)
- Evelyn: badge & key handoff table + checklists (will run the table by the north curb)
- BlueLine / Uber: confirm standby capacity if rideshare surge > 2.0x and ETA SLAs for sedans/vans
- Sarah: confirm drop zones (closest curb, overflow staging) and on-site contact for gate access

Attachments: site_map_v2.pdf (venue drop zones, VIP lane), proposed driver_manifest.csv (template)

Key constraints: VIPs need secure keys transferred to Redwoods' escort; we cannot have keys left in vehicles unattended. Preferred process: BlueLine or on-site courier accepts keys at badge table and signs manifest; if using rental cars, drivers will meet at loading bay and hand keys to Evelyn for secure transfer.

Please reply with: capacity confirmation, surge trigger threshold you recommend, and any rate/card on file constraints we should expect.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Events & Partnerships
Redwood Inference
---

From: Sarah Ortiz <sarah@acme.events>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, BlueLine Ops <ops@blueline.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Nov 2027 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Rideshare surge mitigation + key handoff protocol for 12/11 exec offsite

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear list. Attached is venue_dropzones.xlsx with the preferred north curb as primary, a service lane (~120m) for shuttle staging, and a secondary overflow at Lot C (7 mins away, we can hold 6 vehicles). We can reserve two 15-minute curb windows for VIP arrivals (12:15 and 13:45).

Budget note: Acme covers standard event pickups, but a dedicated contracted fleet (BlueLine) for standby will be billed to the event owner — please confirm if Redwood will cover that or if we should invoice Acme.

On keys: we can provide a locked key cabinet at the badge table supervised by your staff. The venue security requires a signed chain-of-custody form for any keys leaving site.

On rideshare: our local ops recommends setting surge threshold at 1.8x for switching to contracted fleet during 12:00–15:30 window. I can share the local mobility coordinator (Alejandra) if you want live monitoring.

Regards,
Sarah Ortiz
Events Lead — Acme Corp
Attachments: venue_dropzones.xlsx
---

From: BlueLine Ops <ops@blueline.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Sarah Ortiz <sarah@acme.events>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Nov 2027 08:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Rideshare surge mitigation + key handoff protocol for 12/11 exec offsite

Marissa / team —

BlueLine can provide: up to 8 sedans + 3 12-seat vans on standby within the venue perimeter during the arrival window. Our surge trigger recommendation aligns with Sarah (1.8x). Operational notes: 
- Standby activation: client texts our dispatch line (ops@blueline.com) with "ACTIVATE-STANDBY-YYYY" and we move fleet in 12–18 minutes average.
- Pricing: standby rate is $85/hr per sedan (min 2 hrs) while active pickup rate varies by trip distance. If rideshare surge occurs and client asks us to run continuous shuttles, we'll switch sedans -> vans to minimize cost and wait times.
- Key handoff: Drivers will meet at the North Badge Table with printed name placards; we will sign your driver_manifest.csv and place a timestamped receipt in the locked cabinet. BlueLine agrees to the chain-of-custody form.

Attachment: driver_manifest.csv (example row: driver_name,vehicle,plate,arrival_time,passenger_name,signature)

Contingency: If rideshare surge exceeds 2.5x and both our standby and venue shuttles are consumed, we recommend routing some guests to a short-term pickup at Lot C with covered shuttles to the main entrance (5–7 minute transfer).

Let us know if Redwood will handle invoicing or BlueLine should invoice Acme.

Best,
Tomas R. 
Operations Manager — BlueLine Car Service
ops@blueline.com
---

On Tue, 4 Dec 2027 16:45:00 -0800, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com> wrote:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Sarah Ortiz <sarah@acme.events>, BlueLine Ops <ops@blueline.com>
Date: Thu, 04 Dec 2027 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Rideshare surge mitigation + key handoff protocol for 12/11 exec offsite

Marissa / team — confirmed. Final plan notes: 
- Surge threshold: 1.8x to activate BlueLine standby (per Sarah/Tomas).
- On-day roles: Marcus = arrival ops lead, Evelyn = badge & key custody, Kimberly = exec liaison and escalation point for any billing/credit exceptions.
- Keys: Evelyn will maintain locked cabinet; BlueLine will provide signed receipts on pickup. Redwoods will not leave keys in rental vehicles overnight.
- Parking: Lot C reserved (6 spaces) for overflow + short-term shuttle; venue will publish temporary signage.
- Invoicing: Redwood will pick up BlueLine standby charge; we'll charge back Acme per the event agreement. BlueLine, please invoice Redwood (ops@blueline.com) with event code RED-1211.

Marcus: please distribute a one-page on-day playbook (arrival windows, contact numbers, contingency flowchart) by EOD Monday 12/7. Evelyn: draft the key custody checklist and attach to driver_manifest.csv.

Thanks — Kim
Kimberly Park
Head of Customer Events — Redwood Inference

--
Attachments referenced: site_map_v2.pdf, driver_manifest.csv, venue_dropzones.xlsx
